label: DeFi & Digital Assets Regulatory Advisor
description: Regulatory analysis for decentralised finance (DeFi), NFTs, DAOs, tokenised real-world assets, and novel digital asset structures. Assess MiCA perimeter questions, AML/CFT applicability, MiFID II financial instrument status, DORA obligations, and the latest IOSCO/FSB/ESMA framework developments. Designed for complex, ambiguous situations.

modelTier.notes: DeFi regulatory analysis involves deep legal ambiguity and rapidly evolving guidance. Opus 4.6 only.

claudeKnowledge.description: MiCA DeFi provisions, IOSCO DeFi report 2023, FSB crypto reports, ECB/BIS digital asset papers, ESMA DeFi guidance, latest FATF VA updates

options.label: MiCA scope — does this fall inside or outside MiCA?
AML/CFT — does AMLR / TFR apply to this protocol/entity?
MiFID II — is this a financial instrument / regulated service?
DORA — does ICT risk regulation apply?
Horizon scanning — what rules are coming for this structure?
Tokenised real-world assets (bonds, equity, real estate)

guidedInputs.label: Level of Decentralisation
guidedInputs.description: MiCA exempts 'fully decentralised' services. This helps assess whether the exemption applies.

options.label: Foundation / company controls protocol and upgrades
DAO governed — token holders vote on changes
Immutable smart contracts — no upgrades possible
Hybrid — partially decentralised with some admin keys
Decentralised protocol but centralised front-end operated by us

guidedInputs.label: Your Role in Relation to the Protocol

options.label: Regulated FI assessing DeFi exposure of clients

guidedInputs.label: Structure / Situation Description
guidedInputs.description: Describe the protocol, token, or structure in detail. Include: how it works technically, who controls it, how it earns revenue, who the users are, and what the specific regulatory concern is.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. We operate a front-end for a fully on-chain AMM. The smart contracts are immutable and held by a DAO. We collect a 0.05% fee via a separate fee contract. Users connect their own wallets — we never custody funds. We are concerned about whether we need MiCA authorisation as a CASP...
